scope: Overrides comparison-3 generic inventory only. Other checks remain offline contracts. All failed attempts retained.

Recall@K.method: Complete binary labels over four canonical spans, one child per span. Scores measure selected candidate order before packing; denominator K even for fewer hits. MRR cutoff K. NDCG binary gain, log2 discount. Final coverage counts whole gold spans in actual context. Macro means by strategy/variant. Codex reviewed all eight pairs; no human or LLM answer review.
Recall@K.aggregation: Macro mean across four cases per strategy/variant; K=2
Recall@K.reason: Hand-authored frozen plans/vectors, not live planning quality.

First-answer-delta latency.reason: This paired replay is synchronous; browser test durations are not streaming performance.

Complete-response latency.reason: Offline service replay only; no HTTP completion or live provider response timing.

Stage latency.population: Same four offline cases per strategy/variant
Stage latency.method: perf_counter, nearest-rank percentiles, sequential baseline then planned, local storage included; no provider queue/model loading. Detailed query/fusion/packing/planner timings retained in traces. Final mocked generation not separately timed.
Stage latency.reason: Diagnostic timing only; no production improvement claim.

Token usage and cost.reason: Mock SDK responses have no real usage/billing. Serialized input counts and exact evidence tokens are retained separately; no paid calls.

Reliability.method: Completion and saved-history equality assertions; SDK mock has no network retry loop. Earlier runner failures are retained separately.
Reliability.reason: Not provider reliability or production success rate.

Concurrency and throughput.reason: Concurrency is fixed at 1. No load workload or whole-workload timing interval; throughput is not measured.

Ingestion and index.reason: Fixed prebuilt four-span index controls retrieval; no ingestion performance benchmark. Separate browser checks verify upload/delete/history contracts.

environment.models: offline-fixture, offline-planner, offline-answer: test doubles, no model revision
environment.controls: Identical stage 3a frozen corpus/questions/labels/vectors/plans, top_k=2 and budgets. Planner SDK responses replay hand-authored plans via real validation and chat integration. Answer output is a placeholder; no semantic quality evidence. Sequential concurrency one; no paid calls, model loading or queue. Single pass baseline first; mock timings are not production latency.
